objective: Check whether queue pressure forms after initial cached application placement and whether queue-aware penalty changes candidate rank or destination.
staging_basis: Earlier paired 30-UE, 1-second quick runs generated 435 tasks. This step holds workload profile and seed constant and raises the horizon to 5 seconds to expose later queue formation without changing application/device baseline profiles.
observability_change: queue audit now records estimate timestamp, active/queued task counts, penalty, baseline/combined ranks, ranking change, baseline/selected candidate, selected-destination change, and cache flag; lifecycle trace is enabled for both methods.
